_about: Stations of the scout rover part (ASTRA-style UI and scout update). New ids with Godot positions in the Exterior, on open ground away from the map's objects. The scout bay (moved 2026-11-14 from (17, 21.5) to (18, 17), south of the rover garage, so the rover can drive out of the garage door: Prompt 10) holds the half-built scout rover (finished there by the field engineer) and is where it is sent out; the broken-down rover is a salvage donor (data/salvage.json); the ore deposits are found by walking or shown on the map once the scout has surveyed their area (data/scout_sites.json). The 3D models are made at run time by scripts/vehicle/scout_models.gd; the map file is not changed.
